open_work: Fifteen passive clocks keep their original 0.32m width/height, 0.06m depth, X centres and 0.52m row spacing. Explicit +0.30m vertical translation clears the unchanged 1.45m case maxima by 0.03m. Two short rear bearings per clock bridge the existing 0.07m gap to the actual east brick party wall. Original source boxes remain immutable.

Worked octagonal wooden cases alternate with turned brass cases. Thin fixed clear panes cover pale dials, twelve unlettered geometric hour marks and two supported fixed hands. Individual hand poses are decorative stopped stock, without time/signal authority. No numerals, maker marks, new material keys, bitmap content, mechanism or power routes. The existing catalogue library aged-brass variant replaces only the coarse original brass finish locally, with its declared 0.50m chart scale and aged-metal roughness.
Display furniture, stock, ticking/winding/setting behavior, service and continuous routes, weather/glazing, broader texture acceptance and human inspection remain separate open work.
